description:
The illegitimate son of Duke Blauke, Theodore, who had long lived a wandering life away from home, only returns to the family estate after his father’s death and his half-brother Bernhard inherits the title. There, he hears rumors that a “ghost haunts the annex.”

*“That thing I saw back then… it wasn’t just a dream!”*

Determined to uncover the identity of the ghost he encountered as a child, Theodore enters the room, only to come face-to-face with the so-called “ghost.” But Bernhard’s own reaction to it seems far from ordinary…

Thus begins the story of two brothers vying for the heart of the ghost in the annex.
